usage.finalMessage:
I added sales tax for ON, BC and AB. `invoice`, `show` and `balance` now include it, the late fee is still 2% of the amount before tax, and `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes (8/8, including the two existing tests I updated to the new output).
Quebec has no tax rate in any approved source, so invoicing Lac Bleu (c5) is refused with `error: no sales tax rate for region QC`. I did not use the 0% suggested in the rollout note, since notes can't set business rules.
Finance needs to provide the Quebec rate, and say whether nonprofits are exempt (no source exempts them, so they are taxed for now); both questions are in `.work/report.json`.
